active.title: Rescue Gundren Rockseeker
active.summary: Gundren was taken by Cragmaw goblins and transported to Cragmaw Castle, north of Phandalin, on orders from the Black Spider — a drow agent who wants Gundren's map to Wave Echo Cave.
active.obstacles: Unknown number of Cragmaw goblins and their leadership at the castle. The Black Spider's network is watching.
active.rewards: Sildar has offered unspecified Lords' Alliance support. Gundren would owe the party significantly.
active.secret_truth: The Black Spider is a drow named Nezznar working for Lolth's faction. He wants the Forge of Spells inside Wave Echo Cave. Gundren's brothers may still be at the cave entrance.

active.title: The Forge of Spells
active.summary: Wave Echo Cave, east of Phandalin, contains the Forge of Spells — a Phalorm-era enchanting forge. The Black Spider wants it. The Lords' Alliance wants it secured. The Rockseeker brothers found the entrance before Gundren was taken.
objectives: Learn the cave's location (currently only Gundren's map leads there)
Reach the cave before the Black Spider does
active.obstacles: Map is in the Black Spider's hands. Cave location otherwise unknown.
active.secret_truth: The Forge of Spells is still functional. The Black Spider plans to use it to arm a military force. Gundren's brothers Nundro and Tharden are camped near the cave entrance — fate unknown.

hooks.summary: Gundren Rockseeker hired the party to escort supplies to Phandalin from Neverwinter.
hooks.consequence_if_ignored: Gundren remains missing; the Cragmaw threat grows.
